title: MAXA and MINA read TRUE as 1 and text/FALSE as 0 in references, but skip text and logicals inside array literals
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, MAXA and MINA count text and FALSE as 0 and TRUE as 1 when read from worksheet cell references (skipping blank cells), but inside array literals they skip text and logicals just like MAX and MIN: MAXA({-1,TRUE}) is -1, MAXA({-1,"a"}) is -1, MINA({1,TRUE}) is 1, and MINA({1,"a"}) is 1. When given an array containing nested arrays (such as GROUPBY with LAMBDA(x,x)), MAXA returns #N/A.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in dch9u_functions (rows 62-64, 2073) and cfunc_m3_4 (argument_classes rows 88-97), and matched across 1,212/1,212 MAXA and 1,212/1,212 MINA full-bank rows plus 120/120 pinned rows each.
